summary: Single-line text field with a visible label, an optional hint and an error message that screen readers announce.

p.label: Work email
p.hint: We only use it for sign-in links.

whenToUse: Short free-text answers: a name, an email, a search query, an amount.
When the answer cannot be picked from a short, known list.
Use hint for format or privacy notes the user needs before typing, not after.
whenNotToUse: Picking one of fewer than about seven known options: use radio buttons or a select.
Several lines of text: use a textarea (not in the system yet).
Dates: a date picker avoids format errors (not in the system yet).

dos.title: Label above, format help in the hint
dos.text: The label stays visible while typing; the hint answers the question before it is asked.

p.label: Work email
p.hint: We only use it for sign-in links.

dos.title: Errors say how to fix it
dos.text: Name the expected format with an example. Keep the user's value so they can correct it.

p.label: Work email
p.error: Enter an email address like name@company.com.

donts.title: Placeholder used as the label
donts.text: The placeholder disappears on the first keystroke, has low contrast and is not a reliable accessible name.

donts.title: Errors that blame or say nothing
donts.text: "Invalid input" tells the user something is wrong but not what to do next.

accessibility: The label is required by the component's type and is wired with htmlFor: clicking it focuses the field and screen readers read it.
Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby. An error also sets aria-invalid, so it is announced with the field.
The error state uses a red border and a text message: color is never the only signal.
Disabled fields are skipped by keyboard and often not read. For a value the user must see but not change, use read-only.
Set the right type (email, tel, number) and autocomplete so mobile keyboards and autofill do the work.
Known gap: the field border (color.border.strong) is below the 3:1 contrast WCAG asks for input boundaries. It is listed in the contrast matrix and needs a token proposal, not a local override.
